summary: Whole-paper partial extraction of the motivic reduction of p-adic weight–monodromy for smooth scheme-theoretic toric complete intersections. It separates non-fine log geometry, enhanced and rigid motives, normalized HK realizations, arithmetic descent, tubes, toric approximation, the positivity/PD splitting and AppendixA's weight-complex branch. The endpoint's printed connectedness shortcut, conventional Tate shifts, augmentation choices and imported corrected site comparison are explicitly gated. Every missing extracted item has exactly one owner; no formalization or mathematical closure is claimed.

declarations.checked: A simplicial set is a quasicategory when every inner horn has a filler. The pinned class supplies this carrier, not stable presentable infinity-categories or monoidal localizations.

For an abelian category with the indicated localization universe, DerivedCategory is the category of cochain complexes localized at quasi-isomorphisms. It is an ordinary category, not the required enhanced derived category.

For a p-adically complete separated commutative ring R with p prime and nonunit, the pinned ring homomorphism theta:W(R-flat)→R is the inverse limit of its reductions modulo p-powers; theta([x])=x-sharp.
Under the assumptions of theta, the Teichmüller representative of x in the tilt maps to its multiplicative untilt x-sharp.

For a perfect characteristic-p field k, an isocrystal on a W(k)[1/p]-vector space carries a bijective Frobenius-semilinear automorphism. The pinned class does not include monodromy or the geometric realization.

For an integral lattice map N→V into a real vector space, a fan is a finite collection of toric cones closed under faces, with each pairwise intersection a face of both. This is only the combinatorial carrier.
